itemized.notes: Born-digital typed filing, 3 pages. Michael Murphy, County Council Seat F, Republican, Heber City. Primary Report marked with a typed 'X'; initialled MGM twice; signed 'Michael Murphy' dated June 15, 2026. Cover prints $0.00 / $0.00 / $0.00 — internally consistent. Both schedules are the PRINTED-BUT-EMPTY case: the filer typed 'N/A' into the first Date cell of each table and left every other cell blank, then printed $0.00 in each TOTAL. Under the zero-glyph ruling the 'N/A' itself is a non-number and stays blank, but the tables' own printed $0.00 TOTALs are real zeros — so both sides are 'transcribed' with zero rows, which is data, not a gap. THIS FILING IS A CLEAN INSTANCE OF THE PAGE-3 SPILL the brief warns about: Table B's body occupies page 2 and its TOTAL row alone lands on page 3. Reading only pages 1-2 would have left the expenditure total unseen. Not to be confused with Murphy's 2026-03 filing, which already carries 8 itemized expenditure rows from TRANCHE 3 Phase A — this is the JUNE report and it is genuinely empty.
